How to play

Game ends on three emptied market piles or 20 turns; victory cards score.
Higher victory total wins; tie draws. Natural loss to stronger house deck, never survival HP.

How to play
Start ten cards: seven coin-1 and three inert seals. Each turn draw five; one action and one purchase, with explicit +action/+draw effects on market cards. Played/bought cards go to discard, reshuffled only when draw empty. Shared finite market includes coin upgrades, extra-action engines, draw, trash-up-to-two and victory cards that clog hands. Game ends on three emptied market piles or 20 turns; victory cards score.
Higher victory total wins; tie draws. Natural loss to stronger house deck, never survival HP.
